title: Histogram
intent: Show the frequency distribution of one quantitative variable using seven fixed ten-unit bins from 20 through 90.

ai.create: Create a histogram of the value field using the fixed bin boundaries 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, and 90.
ai.maintain: Change the threshold boundaries while keeping the Plot transform and granular D3 transform semantically equivalent.
